design_state: 2004 roadway and retained arch reconstruction v1
primary_source: Primary: 50-page existing-plans bundle, original 1933 arch details plus 2004 B-25747 roadway reconstruction. Pages 40-50 concern a separate pedestrian bridge and are not used for this model. 2026 general plan cross-checks the overall floor envelope.

verified_source_checks.detail: Four whole arch barrels, spandrel walls and hidden fill envelopes. Exact original multi-radius curve and spring haunch thickness remain unresolved.
13.8 m roadway, 17.322 m overall width, 200 mm slab and both sidewalks. End floor limits follow the later general plan; plan flare and localized curb brackets are simplified.
Solid 915 mm parapets, 960 mm pilasters and shallow relief. Panel spacing and texture are representative. Separate pedestrian-bridge sheets 40-50 were excluded.
Three piers and two abutment envelopes. No foundation adequacy or current condition inferred.
Exact arch setting-out, cutwaters, decorative lighting supplied by the city, gauge-well hardware, drainage outlets, rail end flare and approach details remain incomplete.

limits: Exterior visualization reconstruction, not an as-built survey, load rating or validated FEM mesh.
No internal reinforcement, prestressing strands, embedded studs, weld beads or fabrication holes. Material colors are visualization choices.
Source pages mix historical removals and proposed work. Only the explicitly named design state is modeled; the separately stored later references do not alter that state.
Buried foundations are hidden by default. Unknown driven pile lengths, terrain and approach-road terminal systems are omitted.
Bearing contact checks verify constructed geometric attachment only; they do not establish surveyed bearing elevations or fabrication tolerances.
Arch intrados and variable ring thickness are approximate, not original setting-out. 21.946 m clear arch openings differ from pier-center distances and overall floor length.
The 2026 overlay and repair operations are not modeled. The 2004 decorative lighting details supplied by the City of Bluffton are not available in this package.
